prompt:
Create ONE large boss monster sprite for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG battle (a single figure).

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: the light-grey box shows where the boss stands and how big it is (fill the box), the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the boss faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, crisp cel shading and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero.

Image 3 is the APPROVED LOOK of this exact boss in its idle pose (pixel art). Keep the identical design, armour, colours, proportions and size; only the pose changes.

Render as true pixel art: the boss about 140-168 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, rich detail and 3-4 tones per colour like a premium modern pixel-art boss.

Boss: the Hollow Seraph, exactly as in Image 3: the same separate hovering hollow shell plates of blackened steel and brass with open holes and narrow empty gaps, the background seen through them, the glowing clockwork gear heart in the chest gap, the faceless brass helm-mask with the glowing slit, the broken gear-toothed halo close above the helm, exactly four tapering blade wings of cold white-blue light without hilts in brass strut frames joined to the shoulder plates, two on each side. FACE: no face; the faceless brass helm-mask with its glowing slit and the gear heart are the readable features.

Pose: a rite of judgement, a small change from Image 3 and mirror-symmetric: the four blade wings stay in the same four places as in Image 3 (two upper wings pointing up and out, two lower wings pointing down and out) and only spread a little wider to the sides, the upper wing tips no higher than the top of the halo, exactly as high as in Image 3; the two separate floating gauntlets (no arms: empty background between each gauntlet and the shoulder plates, as in Image 3) rise to chest height with open palms, mirror images of each other at the same height, one on each side of the cuirass, both visible; the helm, the cuirass halves, the shoulder plates, the gauntlets and the skirt stay separate pieces hovering apart with the same narrow empty gaps as in Image 3; the gear heart blazing bright white; the halo, the helm, the hollow cuirass and the long wide segmented skirt of plates exactly as in Image 3 (the same shapes, holes, widths and colours, the halo plain brass without a glow); exactly four blade wings and no fifth, each a tapering blade of cold white-blue light with no hilt and no cross-guard, as in Image 3; no blade in front of the body; the whole figure as tall as in Image 3, the halo top and the skirt bottom in the same places as in Image 3, at exactly the same pixel size, well below the top of the grey box; no other effects, no light rays or trails, facing right.

MOVEMENT: this is a dramatic ACTION frame of a huge, intimidating boss, not a static stance. Keep the front or three-quarter front view of Image 3 and a symmetric, composed posture, the armour upright or tilted only slightly; all four blade wings stay separately visible in their brass frames, two on the left side of the image and two on the right side of the image, none hidden behind the armour or bunched together; the plates keep their narrow gaps; the idle shows it at its lowest, here it hovers a little higher; the movement is in the wings, gauntlets and halo, and trailing parts lag behind the motion. The silhouette must be very different from the idle reference. Any part of the body or weapon may reach beyond the sides of the grey box. BODY: hovering above the ground, nothing touches the ground, no shadow, no water. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

Only the boss: no other characters, no scenery, no floor tiles, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no shadows, no borders, no panels.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a face, skin, a body or bones inside the armour, feathers, feathered wings, more or fewer than four wings, six wings, three wings on a side, a horizontal middle wing, a sword in the hands, a sword, a hilt, a cross-guard, a pommel, a handle, solid armour, cream or gold-white blades, white-and-gold armour, a cape, violet, purple, pink, magenta.
